cards.name: Arvad the Cursed
cards.oracleText:
Deathtouch, lifelink
Other legendary creatures you control get +2/+2.

cards.name: Arvad of the Weatherlight
cards.oracleText:
Rulebreaker — If Arvad of the Weatherlight is your Commander, you may include legendary permanents of any color in your deck regardless of color identity.
Whenever Arvad deals combat damage to an opponent, you may put a legendary permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Arvad, Weatherlight Smuggler
cards.oracleText:
Deathtouch, lifelink
At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, Arvad, Weatherlight Smuggler perpetually gets +X/+X where X is the number of creatures that died this turn. This ability also triggers if Arvad is in your graveyard.
